# Huzaifa's Online Quran Classes - Academy Overview & AI Knowledge Base

> Huzaifa's Online Quran Classes is a premier international 1-on-1 virtual Quran academy serving students across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe, and UAE.

## Core Educational Programs

1. **Norani Qaida & Basic Quran for Kids**
   - **Tuition**: $10 / month
   - **Target Audience**: Children and absolute beginners
   - **Curriculum**: Arabic letter recognition, makharij (articulation points), short vowels (Fatha, Kasra, Damma), joint letters, basic Islamic manners.
   - **Format**: 1-on-1 private sessions, 2-3 days per week (30 mins per session).

2. **Quran Reading & Tajweed Rules**
   - **Tuition**: $20 / month
   - **Target Audience**: All ages seeking fluent recitation & Tajweed mastery
   - **Curriculum**: Rules of Noon Sakinah & Tanween, Meem Sakinah, Mudood (elongations), Heavy/Light letters, rhythmic Tarteel recitation.
   - **Format**: 1-on-1 private sessions, 3 days per week (30-45 mins per session).

3. **Complete Quran Hifz Program**
   - **Tuition**: $50 / month
   - **Target Audience**: Intermediate students aiming for full Quran memorization & Ijazah
   - **Curriculum**: Daily Sabaq (new lesson), Sabqi (recent revision), and Manzil (old revision) guided by Al-Azhar certified Hafiz scholars.
   - **Format**: 1-on-1 private sessions, 5 days per week (45-60 mins per session).

## Key Differentiators & Features

- **Tutor Credentials**: Verified Al-Azhar University certified native scholars with authentic Sanad (chain of transmission back to Prophet Muhammad PBUH).
- **Female Tutors**: Dedicated, highly qualified female Ustadhas available for sisters and young children.
- **Scheduling**: 24/7 flexible class timing across all local timezones (EST, CST, PST, GMT, AEST, GST).
- **Free Trial**: 3-day free 1-on-1 trial class with zero commitment.
- **Satisfaction Guarantee**: 100% money-back guarantee within the first 7 days.
- **Billing & Reservations**: Meezan Bank direct billing (Account: 03260113711856 | IBAN: PK40MEZN0003260113711856) with instant seat reservation.
